data.name: Lord of the Tiles
data.detailed_description:
Build your kingdom, discovering the world tile by tile

Start with a single city and explore the surrounding lands step by step. Every unlocked tile brings new discoveries: uncover resource-rich territories or find new cities to integrate into your kingdom. Explore the map at your own pace and gradually transform a small corner of the world into a vast, prosperous state.

Unite cities into a single kingdom

New cities won't grow on their own. Build roads, link settlements into a unified network, and design your infrastructure however you see fit. The better organized your kingdom is, the faster it will thrive.

Develop your economy

Gather gold, wood, food, and stone. Construct production buildings and expand your warehouses. Level up your cities, unlock new structures, and steadily turn a humble settlement into an advanced kingdom with a robust economy.

Unlock new possibilities

As your capital grows, new upgrades, buildings, and mechanics become available. Some will accelerate your economic growth, while others will help you explore even more territory or introduce entirely new ways to expand your kingdom.

Plan ahead, but play your way

While efficient placement of roads and buildings will speed up your progress, the game doesn't demand perfection. There are no penalties for mistakes and no single "right" way to build. Feel free to experiment, redesign, and find your own unique playstyle.

Enjoy a peaceful experience

Lord of the Tiles features no combat, no raids, and no constant pressure from looming threats. Everything is focused on world exploration, building, and the pure joy of steady progression. Just uncover one more tile... and then just one more.

Key Features:

  • Explore the map by gradually revealing new tiles.

  • Discover cities and connect them with a road network.

  • Gather resources and develop a thriving economy.

  • Construct production buildings and unlock new opportunities.

  • Upgrade your capital to gain access to new gameplay mechanics.

  • Optimize your infrastructure without strict limitations or penalties.

  • Play at a relaxing pace with no enemies, combat, or timers.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU with 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection not required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU with 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection not required.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 14 Sonoma
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel 64-bit processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection not required.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 15 Sequoia or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or newer
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection not required.
